title: After Save the walk
question: #116: Save the walk now goes straight back to the Outreach page you started from. It needs a short, quiet word there that the walk was saved. Which look?

options.label: A: A saved box at the top of Outreach
options.thesis: Where the "Your walk is on" card sat, a sand box says the walk is saved, with its distance and letterboxes and a link to My outreach. It stays until you leave the page.
options.viewport: Outreach: masthead, the saved box, then Got an hour? and the rows.
options.risk: Pushes Got an hour? down a little while it shows.

options.label: B: A short note above the tab bar
options.thesis: A navy note floats above the tab bar for a few seconds ("Walk saved · 62 letterboxes", My outreach), then goes.
options.viewport: Outreach as it is, with the note above the tabs.
options.risk: A new kind of thing in the app; easy to miss if you look away.

options.label: C: Said in the masthead
options.thesis: The masthead's beige line says "Walk saved: 1.4 km, 62 letterboxes. Thank you." until you leave; nothing else moves.
options.viewport: Outreach with the saved words in the masthead.
options.risk: The quietest; no link to My outreach.
